outcome.note: Blue=treated, red=control. Square=S=+1, circle=S=−1, bold=avg over S. S shifts BOTH arms by 5 (strong confounding); treatment adds 3X.

cate.note: CATE=3X for both S, so the optimal policy is treat iff X>0.

sx.note: Strong S-X correlation so balancing X reaches the hidden S.

prop.note: STRONG selection on S (e=σ(4S−2X)): a big confounding bias that fools naive XX into over-treating, even with no cap.

obs.note: Observed imbalance per level (the residual the Wasserstein term corrects).

uncap_value.note: UNCAPPED: realised E[Y] vs Γ, N=700, 5-seed mean. Both OW methods (circles) beat EVERY other method (incl plain DoublyRobust-X-X) at small Γ; matched Γ≈5 so the win is at Γ≈1.5-2.

uncap_policy.note: UNCAPPED deployed π(treat|X). Γ + seed dropdowns. Default is the across-seed average; pick a single seed to see its exact policy (note the policy chart and the value chart's 5-seed mean are different aggregations).

cap_value.note: CAPPED (treat<=50%): realised E[Y] vs Γ, N=700, 5-seed mean. Both OW methods (circles) beat EVERY other method (incl plain DoublyRobust-X-X) at small Γ; matched Γ≈5 so the win is at Γ≈1.5-2.

cap_policy.note: CAPPED deployed π(treat|X). Γ + seed dropdowns. Default is the across-seed average; pick a single seed to see its exact policy (note the policy chart and the value chart's 5-seed mean are different aggregations).
